title: When Email Becomes Everyone’s Dependency
description: An educational case study of the November 12–13, 2026 Microsoft 365 outage: feature-level impact, shared dependencies, recovery milestones, and response questions. Dated research snapshot, not a final postmortem.
previewNote: Four selected screenshots from actual native playback. Incident snapshot: November 13, 2026, 22:00 UTC. Sources and qualifications are included in speaker notes; conceptual diagrams and presenter analysis are labeled.
